name: News & weather
description: Today’s date, local weather and a few top headlines from Google News over the day’s selected artwork. This Astro layout owns its Google News RSS and Open-Meteo integration.

settings.label: News edition
settings.description: The Google News country and language for headlines and topics.

settings.label: Topics
settings.description: Choose up to six topics. Their headlines merge into one list, taking turns. With no topics, the screen shows top stories.

fields.label: Search (optional)
fields.description: Enter words to follow, for example Red Sox. When this has text, the row shows search results and ignores the topic above.

settings.label: Weather location
settings.description: City and state or country, for example Boston, MA. Leave blank to hide the weather.

display_settings.label: Show the artwork behind the news
display_settings.description: Turn this off to show the news and weather on a plain dark background on this TV.
